inputs.prompt: Photorealistic premium cinematic science-fiction, coherent anatomy and motion, restrained production design. Use <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3> only as identity and wardrobe references. Whenever a referenced person appears, preserve that exact face, hair, body, clothing colors, scars, tattoos, and mechanical limbs. Never swap identities or costumes. Create a continuous 15-second cinematic science-fiction shot at 24 fps, 736x416 in the narrow reactor corridor of the Aster Vale under flickering red emergency lights. Picture 1 is Commander Lyra Voss, the same Black woman with silver side-braids, right-eyebrow scar, and navy pressure suit with burnt-orange shoulder stripe, moving toward camera. Picture 2 is Engineer Ren Ito, the same East Asian man with short black hair, subtle stubble, mechanical left forearm, and off-white/teal technical suit, running beside her and checking a sparking wall conduit with his mechanical hand. Picture 3 is Scout Sera Kade, the same pale freckled woman with auburn bob, green eyes, triangular tattoo beneath her left eye, and charcoal suit with cyan seam lights, following while looking back toward the cargo bay. Maintain exact faces, clothes, scale, and left-right identity. From 0–5s, retreat in front of the three as corridor lights fail behind them in sequence; from 5–10s, Ren plants his mechanical left palm against a panel and blue sparks crawl over the metal fingers; from 10–15s, artificial gravity stutters, lifting all three briefly before they catch handrails. Native stereo audio: urgent footsteps, alarms, electrical crackle on the left, metal groan on the right, heartbeat-like bass and rising strings. Lyra says, “Isolate the cargo bay.” No subtitles, readable text, logos, extra people, gore, or camera cuts.
